lines.en: - I want pie. - No, no, no, no, no, no pie.
- Why? - We're trying to make it last
till Mr. Gallini's out of the hospital.
Well...
Well, then how come Sam gets some?
Sam doesn't get any--
- Put that down! - Oh, no, put the pie down!
Sam, you put that pie down! Put it down!
Put the pie down! Put it down, put the pie down!
Give me the pie! Give me the pie!
Give me, give me some more pie!
Give me the pie!
No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no!
- Don't eat the pie! - Don't eat the pie!
- They don't have pie! - Whoa, whoa, whoa!
Calm down! Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!
Calm down. What's going on?
Sam's got the pie.
Ah!
I don't know what's going on!
She locked herself in the bathroom.
Well, that's it. She's gonna sit down in there and finish it.
